results.question: What were the 3 most common causes of subway delays in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT COALESCE(dc.description, sd.code) AS cause, COUNT(*) AS delay_count FROM subway_delays AS sd LEFT JOIN delay_codes AS dc ON sd.code = dc.code WHERE sd.occurred_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND sd.occurred_at < CAST('2026-01-01' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND sd.min_delay > 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.description, sd.code) ORDER BY delay_count DESC, cause LIMIT 3
results.answer: The 3 most common causes of subway delays in 2025 were DISORDERLY PATRON with 1,156 incidents, PAA – NO TROUBLE FOUND with 710 incidents, and INJURED/ILL CUSTOMER ON TRAIN – MEDICAL AID REFUSED with 648 incidents.

results.question: In 2023, what was the average streetcar delay on weekends compared with weekdays?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, CAST(AVG(min_delay) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS avg_streetcar_delay_minutes FROM streetcar_delays WHERE occurred_at >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND occurred_at < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND min_delay > 0 GROUP BY is_weekend ORDER BY day_type LIMIT 100
results.answer: In 2023, the average streetcar delay was 18.2 minutes on weekends compared with 17.8 minutes on weekdays.

results.question: Compare total delay minutes for subway, bus and streetcar in 2024.
results.sql: SELECT 'subway' AS mode, SUM(min_delay) AS total_delay_minutes FROM subway_delays WHERE occurred_at >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND occurred_at < CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) UNION ALL SELECT 'bus' AS mode, SUM(min_delay) AS total_delay_minutes FROM bus_delays WHERE occurred_at >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND occurred_at < CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) UNION ALL SELECT 'streetcar' AS mode, SUM(min_delay) AS total_delay_minutes FROM streetcar_delays WHERE occurred_at >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND occurred_at < CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) ORDER BY total_delay_minutes DESC LIMIT 100
results.answer: In 2024, bus had 1,259,884 minutes of total delay, streetcar had 226,647 minutes, and subway had 74,209 minutes. Bus had the most delay minutes, followed by streetcar, then subway.

results.question: What was the most common reason for bus delays in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT COALESCE(dc.description, bd.code) AS reason, COUNT(*) AS delay_count FROM bus_delays AS bd LEFT JOIN delay_codes AS dc ON bd.code = dc.code AND dc.mode = 'bus' WHERE bd.occurred_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND bd.occurred_at < CAST('2026-01-01' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY COALESCE(dc.description, bd.code) ORDER BY delay_count DESC, reason LIMIT 1
results.answer: The most common reason for bus delays in 2025 was **OTHER**, with **15,902 incidents**.

results.question: Which full calendar year had the most subway delays?
results.sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM occurred_at) AS INT) AS year, COUNT(*) AS delay_count FROM subway_delays WHERE occurred_at >= CAST('2014-01-01' AS DATE) AND occurred_at < DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY delay_count DESC, year ASC LIMIT 1
results.answer: The full calendar year with the most subway delays was 2024, with 26,402 incidents.
